name: Dong-Geun Kim
bio: I am a Ph.D. candidate at POSTECH Interaction Lab. I study how touch can deliver information, shape perception, and create new ways to interact. My current work explores a tactile Korean system for people with sensory impairments.

research.name: Tactile communication
research.description: Encoding language and information into patterns that can be felt on the skin.

research.name: Vibrotactile perception
research.description: Understanding how the timing and location of vibration shape what we perceive.

research.name: Mid-air haptics
research.description: Exploring contactless touch and how wrist vibration enhances ultrasonic sensations.

education.institution: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)
education.degree: Integrated M.S./Ph.D. in IT Convergence Engineering

education.institution: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)

experience.description: Developed high-frequency ultrasound transducers for tactile applications.

projects.name: Tactile Korean System for the Visually and Hearing Impaired (PM)
projects.description: Conducting research on tactile delivery of Korean language using vibrotactile arrays to support communication for people with sensory disabilities.

projects.name: Mid-air Haptic Rendering for Digital Twin (PM)
projects.description: Leading the development of real-time mid-air haptic rendering technologies. Researched enhancing perceived intensity of weak stimuli using cognitive modulation.

projects.name: Investigating the Luxuriousness of Haptic Warning
projects.description: Explored user perception of luxurious haptic warning feedback on steering wheels.

projects.name: Performance Metric for User Experience
projects.description: Designed metrics to assess UX in digital environments. Improved UX through cross-modal matching of sound and touch.

projects.name: Multimodal Haptic Tool for AR Sports
projects.description: Designed devices rendering realistic haptic sensations by combining vibration, shear force, and impact feedback.
